name: stirling-pdf
description: Edit, convert, compress, secure and sign PDFs with Stirling PDF.

interface.longDescription:
Stirling PDF brings a full PDF toolkit into ChatGPT. Attach a file or pick one from your device, then ask in plain language.

What you can do:
- Convert PDFs to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, HTML and Markdown
- Compress, merge, split, rotate, reorder and remove pages
- Run OCR on scanned documents to make them searchable
- Add or remove passwords, redact text, add watermarks and digital signatures
- Extract images, tables and metadata

Every result comes back as a file card with a download button. Your original file is never changed, and results are only reachable through a short-lived private link.

Sign in with your Stirling PDF account. Usage counts against your Stirling PDF plan.

positive.prompt: Compress this PDF so it is small enough to email.
positive.expected_behavior: A file card shows the compressed PDF with its new size and a working Download button.

positive.description: Convert an attached PDF to Word
positive.prompt: Turn this PDF into a Word document.
positive.expected_behavior: A file card shows a .docx result that downloads and opens in Word.

positive.prompt: Rotate every page of this PDF by 90 degrees.
positive.expected_behavior: A file card shows the rotated PDF; downloading it shows all pages rotated.

positive.prompt: Add the password 'review-2026' to this PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: A file card shows the protected PDF; opening it asks for the password.

positive.description: Pick a file without attaching it
positive.prompt: I want to compress a PDF from my computer.
positive.expected_behavior: A file picker appears in the chat; after choosing a PDF the assistant compresses it and shows a file card.
